items.headline: What Week 12's unexpected results mean for Rivalry Week and beyond
items.description: After another chaotic weekend, we look at the playoff and conference races on the line with one game to go.

items.headline: Jones' 2TDs help lead Miami (Ohio) to dominant 20-3 win over Kent State
items.description: — D'Shawntae Jones ran for 121 yards and two touchdowns, and Miami (Ohio) beat Kent State 20-3 on Tuesday night.

items.headline: Miami (OH) and Kent State meet in MAC action
items.description: Miami (OH) (6-4) at Kent State (3-7), Nov. 17 at 7 p.m. EST.

items.headline: Sizing up college football's best races down the homestretch
items.description: From spots in the CFP and SEC title game to the hunt for bowl eligibility, there's still a lot on the line.

items.headline: Wake Forest's post-blowout jab at SMU tops college football Week 11 trolls
items.description: Wake Forest dominated SMU on the gridiron Saturday -- and added insult to injury after the game.

items.headline: Miami (Ohio) flagged for distracting images during FG attempt
items.description: Miami (Ohio) was penalized for unsportsmanlike conduct for displaying multiple images of uprights on a stadium video screen during an opponent's field goal attempt.
